ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) central fields comprising approximately 70% of the visible surface, contrasted by low-intensity (black) boundaries and hinge regions comprising approximately 30%.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Medial sections of both lobes feature contiguous white pigmentation. The right lobe exhibits dense black stippling and mottling concentrated near the hinge and trailing edge. The left lobe features a cleaner white field with a localized black crescent-shaped marker on the distal-lateral edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; notch depth is distinct and sharply defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous micro-serration along the trailing edges of both lobes; a prominent irregular indentation is visible on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral upward sweep from the hinge; trailing edges follow a convex arc toward the tips with a slight recurve at the distal ends.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Visible clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular barnacle rosettes localized on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (superficial scratches) visible on the medial white field of the left lobe; no parallel rake marks detected.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized clusters of barnacles (rosettes) attached to the extreme distal edges of both lobes; significant dark pigmentation mottling on the inner right lobe suggestive of historic scarring or natural variation.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique dark semi-circular or 'hook' pigmentation mark located on the interior boundary of the left lobe's white field.
